name: pi-file-guard
description: User-controlled DENY/READ/WRITE filesystem policy for the Pi coding agent (Linux + bubblewrap). /hide secrets, /lock production files — enforced on file tools and every bash/fd/rg subprocess through one shared bwrap filesystem view.
author: Pi File Guard contributors

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/policy.test.ts tests/paths.test.ts tests/state.test.ts tests/bwrap.test.ts tests/find.test.ts tests/grep.test.ts tests/search-security.test.ts tests/search-performance.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
